LESSON: PLEDGES OF AQABAH

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.2: Pledges of Aqabah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Pledges of Aqabah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did Muslims benefit from the pledges of Aqabah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah
2. state the terms of the pledges of Aqabah
3. appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model A for “describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: state the terms of the pledges of Aqabah

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah
• Model 2: state the terms of the pledges of Aqabah
• Model 3: appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah
2. Practise: state the terms of the pledges of Aqabah
3. Practise: appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Pledges of Aqabah.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Muslims benefit from the pledges of Aqabah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the events that led to the signing of the pledges of Aqabah
• state the terms of the pledges of Aqabah
• appreciate the pledges of Aqabah as a base for the migration of Muslims in Madina
